notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) only - direct HTTP fetch via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome124) succeeded on every page (200s, some transient 403s from Cloudflare cleared on a short-delay retry with the same impersonation); no Playwright/Chrome needed. robots.txt (User-agent: * / Disallow: /healthcheck only; explicit Allow: for Claude-User/ChatGPT-User/Perplexity-User) placed no restriction on this research. TREE: ProCook is a kitchenware/cookware retailer with 8 top nav sections (kitchen-accessories, cookware-and-bakeware, drinkware, electricals, knives-scissors, special-offers, summer, tableware-dining) - no bedroom/bathroom/living-room sections exist. Built the tree from sitemap.xml (2641 URLs) filtered for textile/storage keywords, cross-checked against each hub page's own subcategory tile carousel (regex on class="block mb-3" title="..." tiles) to confirm true parent/child relationships, since the generic mega-menu and a sitewide 'explore categories' band both repeat on every page and are not reliable hierarchy signals. Confirmed hubs: kitchen-accessories/textiles -> Aprons, Oven Gloves, Tea Towels, Textile Sets; kitchen-accessories/storage -> Food Storage, Kitchen Storage, Glass Food Storage, Plastic Food Storage. tableware-dining/shop-all-table-accessories (mixed-category hub, not itself Textile) -> Tablecloths and Napkins, Placemats/Coasters/Runners (leaves kept, hub not emitted as group since it is not exclusively Textile). Spice Racks, Storage Jars, Knife Storage Blocks and Knife Wrap and Rack Sets are independently valid category pages (own h1/canonical/product-count) found via sitemap+nav but not shown in the narrow hub carousels, so kept as standalone leaves rather than nested under Storage. QTY: exact 'totalProducts' integer read from the escaped React-server-component JSON payload embedded in each category page's HTML (e.g. ..."totalProducts":74...), cross-checked against the page's own h1 and canonical URL on every leaf. EXCLUDED and why: kitchen-accessories/shop-all-storage (100) and shop-all-textiles (44) = 'Shop All' aggregator pages, not genuine subcategories; kitchen-accessories/aprons-oven-gloves-tea-towels (21) = exact sum of Aprons(5)+Oven Gloves(13)+Tea Towels(3), a combo/aggregator view, not a distinct subcategory; summer/food-storage-summer (73) = seasonal duplicate/near-duplicate of Food Storage, promotional landing page; summer/shop-all-summer-cooking-and-food-storage = 404, does not exist; kitchen-accessories/dish-drainers-racks-mats (h1 'Dish drainers and mats', 7) = drying accessory, primary purpose is washing-up not storage or textile; kitchen-accessories/sink-cloths-sponges-scourers (h1 'Sponges and scrubbers', 3) = primarily sponges/scourers, not a textile-cloth category despite the slug; kitchen-accessories/utensil-pots-and-holders (h1 'Utensil holders', 10) = countertop utensil crock, not confirmed as part of the Storage hub tree and closer to a kitchen-accessory caddy than a genuine storage/organization system, excluded per ambiguity guidance rather than force-included; kitchen-accessories/trivets (h1 'Trivets and worktop savers', 9) = hot-pad kitchen accessory, neither textile nor storage; tableware-dining/tableware-accessories (h1 'Table decorations', 4) = decorative, not textile; cookware-and-bakeware/roasting-racks = in-oven cooking accessory, not storage; knives-scissors/knife-sets-with-blocks, knife-sets-with-magnetic-knife-racks, knife-sets-without-storage = the primary product in these categories is a knife SET (knives are the product, storage is a bundled extra), not a storage product itself, so excluded even though the standalone Knife Storage Blocks / Knife Wrap and Rack Sets categories (where the storage accessory itself is the product) were included. No fabrication; no product-detail/search/View-All/Collection URLs used; no quantities estimated or aggregated.
